dog.description_text:
My foster writes:
Rumor has it Vogue called asking if Hallie PeÃ±a could be their next cover star, but she was far too busy lounging in her foster home to take the call. Hallie is a BEAUTIFUL young lady full of star power, and is now seeking a full-time photographer (a.k.a forever human) of her own.

Hallie PeÃ±a had a difficult time in the shelter--after losing her owner and her home, who could blame her? After three weeks in her foster home, Hallie has made incredible progress and has become a certified lap cat in training. While she's still working her way up to being comfortable with petting, she loves to lay on your legs for treats and sleep curled up next to your lap.

She is an elegant, beautiful young lady with all of the feline refinements you could desire-she's a superstar litterbox user, quiet as a mouse, and never picky about food. Like all supermodels, she has no problem being admired, and enjoys lounging in the same room as her humans (bonus points if there's a window for her to gaze out of). Her likes are heated blankets, feather toys, and crunchy treats, and she will come equipped with her favorite catnip banana toy.

Hallie is looking for a patient, admiring human who respects body language and is excited to take part in her journey from lap cat in training to absolute snuggle bug. If that's you, Hallie PeÃ±a is ready for her close-up!
